value.rationale: Paley-37 is a canonical small self-complementary strongly regular graph. Exact 26-torsion, especially its 13-primary part, is not visible to rational eigenvalue/Betti calculations and contrasts with published order-29 two-torsion. A complete integral homotopy type, not a disconnected arbitrary invariant, supports research into torsion phenomena in clique complexes.
